scope: Correction of all three MVC observations after the user withdrew acceptance. Original reviewed proposal and integration/withdrawal records remain retained.

failures.reason: Reader error in the new emitter let bindings; no generated result claimed.
The new captured literal case expected zero heap bytes but its shared variable cell correctly costs eight bytes. Corrected the literal expectation, not the emitter.
The inherited mvc_closure case still charged a heap function/environment after their move to stack storage. Preserved the original cases and corrected that expectation to its eight-byte cell.
The first cursor-reclamation edit declared the high-water variable but failed to update the release body. The restored-cursor assertion rejected it; release now trims trailing free blocks.
The escaping-inner-closure case initially overcounted its two-cell environment by eight bytes. The source-derived total is 16 cell bytes, 24 function bytes and 16 environment bytes.
Small frames did not expose missing relocation; added the independently sized 64-binding frame counterexample.

inspection_correction: Dynamic control records take ownership of results rather than allocating a second retention buffer after the protected form succeeds. Exhaustion cases verify cleanup effects at exact temporary-storage bounds.
inherited_regressions: Binding-data rewrite, keyword-token overlap, special-package identity and obsolete registry collision remain exercised; their original histories stay in predecessor packets.
